issues.required_property: Each finite run slot must enforce its declared command and prerequisite before launching, so correction, recovery, validator, and review runs cannot execute out of order or exceed the authorized run budget.
issues.description: The plan adds executable commands and outcome rules for all conditional recovery slots, but capture183.py does not enforce those conditions. It checks prior result files only for t2-red; it does not require a failed eligible t1-green before t1-correction, a passing correction before t1-final, the corresponding t2/t3 prerequisites, or a passing selected full suite before t3-validators/t3-review. For counted slots other than the two RED cases, it validates test count and generic success but not the slot-specific argv, so a substituted command with the same count can occupy the slot. Exclusive per-slot directories prevent replay of the same name, while later review validation is post hoc and cannot prevent an unauthorized run or source mutation.
issues.fix_hint: Have the capture utility validate an allowlisted argv per slot and consume/check the preceding captured result and source identity before spawning; refuse duplicate, premature, unused, or ineligible slots.
